answer: In PoA, an agent’s identity is tied to a remotely attested enclave whose code and configuration produce a verified MRENCLAVE, so a copied VM cannot reproduce the authorized hardware-backed identity or forge its reports. Creating another identity therefore requires provisioning distinct trusted silicon and passing attestation, making Sybil expansion costly through physical hardware rather than software cloning. Each sonnet, ripple, and thread remains attributable to its measured agent.
